privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: At ISC Expo - Icon Skill & Career Expo, we take your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacyPage.infoWeCollect: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, phone number, email address, educational qualifications, and payment details when you register, enroll in courses, or contact us.
privacyPage.howWeUse: We use your information to process enrollments, manage payments, send notifications about courses and exams, improve our services, and comply with legal obligations.
privacyPage.dataSharing: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with trusted service providers (payment processors, SMS gateways) solely for operational purposes.
privacyPage.dataRetention: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You may request deletion of your data by contacting us.
privacyPage.yourRights: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can update your profile from the dashboard or contact us for assistance.
privacyPage.contact: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at {email} or call {phone}.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.intro: By using ISC Expo - Icon Skill & Career Expo services, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
termsPage.accounts: You must provide accurate information when registering. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
termsPage.enrollment: Enrollment is confirmed upon fee payment. Fees are non-transferable. The institute reserves the right to modify course schedules with prior notice.
termsPage.payments: All fees must be paid by the due date. Refund requests are subject to the refund policy. Late payments may result in suspension of services.
termsPage.conduct: Students must maintain respectful behavior towards teachers and fellow students. The institute reserves the right to suspend or terminate enrollment for misconduct.
termsPage.intellectualProperty: All course materials, notes, and content provided by ISC Expo are for personal use only. Redistribution or commercial use is prohibited.
termsPage.limitation: ISC Expo shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.
termsPage.contact: For questions about these terms, contact us at {email} or call {phone}.

refundPolicyPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicyPage.intro: This refund policy outlines the terms and conditions for fee refunds at ISC Expo - Icon Skill & Career Expo.
refundPolicyPage.cancellation: Refund requests must be submitted in writing within 7 days of enrollment. A processing fee may be deducted. No refunds will be issued after 14 days of enrollment or after course materials have been accessed.
refundPolicyPage.partial: In cases where a course is cancelled by the institute, a full refund will be provided. For students who withdraw mid-course, refunds are calculated on a pro-rata basis at the institute's discretion.
refundPolicyPage.processing: Refunds are processed within 15-20 business days after approval. Refunds will be made via the original payment method or bank transfer.
refundPolicyPage.exceptions: No refunds apply to model test fees, online exam fees, or promotional offers. The institute reserves the right to make final decisions on all refund requests.
refundPolicyPage.contact: For refund inquiries, contact us at {email} or call {phone}. Please include your enrollment details.
